items.name: El Impoluto
items.where: Map coords 117, 841. It rams head-on, then circles just outside your cannon range.
items.gate: No level gate; a fully upgraded ship and all officers are recommended
items.reward: Money and a legendary ship cosmetic. How to beat: copy its pattern - ram it back, fire Burning Shot before leaving its range, use the mortar while out of range, then ram again; brace to soak damage.

items.name: La Dama Negra
items.where: Map coords 240, 72. Relies on mortar barrages; generally the easiest legendary ship.
items.gate: No level gate; fully upgraded ship and all officers recommended
items.reward: Money and a legendary ship cosmetic. How to beat: stay close, fire Heated Shot broadsides and brace right after; fire your own mortar when it stops to set up its mortar.

items.name: HMS Prince
items.where: Map coords 854, 55. Has three health phases and hides in fog between them.
items.gate: No level gate; fully upgraded ship and all officers recommended
items.reward: Money and a legendary ship cosmetic. How to beat: at close-to-medium range use Heated Shot and brace while it reloads. After each phase it vanishes in fog and mortars you for one to two minutes - sail in circles and brace when needed. When it returns, ram head-on (Ram-Dash, needs The Padre), then stay in range for Burning Shot.

items.name: HMS Fearless
items.where: Map coords 811, 858, fought together with Royal Sovereign: two Man-o-Wars, one black-sailed and one white-sailed, moving as a pair.
items.gate: No level gate; fully upgraded ship and all officers recommended
items.reward: Money and legendary ship cosmetics (source does not split rewards between the two). How to beat: fire the mortar while they turn, Ram-Dash one ship, brace against its cannons and hit its back with Burning Shot; swivel gun on red weak spots. Do not chase them (they throw barrels). When one sinks the other turns more aggressive. Each has about half the health of a single legendary ship but the fight is hardest as both fire at you; neither can be boarded to repair.

items.name: Royal Sovereign
items.where: Same encounter and coordinates as HMS Fearless (811, 858).
items.gate: No level gate; fully upgraded ship and all officers recommended
items.reward: Money and legendary ship cosmetics (shared with HMS Fearless). Same tactics as HMS Fearless.

gaps: Source never names regions except calling the Fearless/Royal Sovereign fight north-east.
Source gives no separate rewards for the two Man-o-War ships.
Source counts 5 ships, with the last two as one fight.
notes: Beating all legendary ships unlocks the Devil of the Caribbean trophy/achievement.
